name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-es-es
$comment: Data-only overlay. Shares model.onnx + tokenizer.model with en-us via mailwoman.baseWeights.

es_artifacts.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R11 (2026-08-02). The Spanish instance of the dependent-locality prior.

pair_index_es_bin.format: PIX1 placetype-pair index — a retrieval-augmented (barrio, municipio) dependent_locality prior, e.g. ("Aravaca", "Madrid")
pair_index_es_bin.source: Who's On First admin hierarchy. No postal register carries the sub-city line for this country, so WOF is the source — the same call the US, DE and IN instances made.
pair_index_es_bin.delta_calibration: δ=10, transitionBeta=5 — inherited from GB per R5's uniform-deficit finding.
pair_index_es_bin.requires_leading_postcode_strip: INERT without the `es` entries in SEGMENT_PARENT_POSTCODE_SHAPES and LEADING_POSTCODE_COUNTRIES (neural/placetype-pair-prior.ts) — Spanish addresses write the postcode first.
pair_index_es_bin.parent_alias_expansion: ENABLED. WOF stores `Cordoba` for a city written `Córdoba`, and the fold does NOT strip accents — the two are different keys. Aliases are drawn from names whose language is OFFICIAL for the country (codex isOfficialLanguage) plus English, and must be LATIN-SCRIPT — the model never sees other scripts.
pair_index_es_bin.not_committed: derived artifact, .gitignore'd — rebuilt via `mailwoman gazetteer pair-index --out neural-weights-es-es --country es --delta 10 --transition-beta 5 --borough-db <wof/admin-global-priority.db>`
